title: The Lorentz factor γ
caption: γ = 1/√(1 − v²/c²) stays close to 1 until v is a large fraction of c, then climbs steeply. At 0.6c it is 1.25; at 0.8c, 1.67; for the muons at 0.999c, 22.4: their 2.2 μs lifetime becomes 49 μs in the lab, long enough to travel about 15 km and reach the ground from 15 km.
alt: Lorentz factor against speed as a fraction of c: nearly flat at 1, then rising steeply towards infinity at 1, with points at 0.6, 0.8 and 0.999.
description: β = 0.999: γ = 22.37. Muon lifetime in the lab: 22.4 × 2.2 μs = 49 μs.
Distance in that time: 0.999c × 49 μs ≈ 15 km, more than 15 km.
